channel.title: pathmatics.io
channel.description: Notes on vector generation, path quality and the API, from the team building Pathmatics.

item.title: A PDF that is really vectors
item.description: The PDF export writes path data, not pixels.

item.title: Drafts before the final path
item.description: A generation on arrow-1.1 returns nothing at all for roughly fourteen seconds, and no amount of engineering on our side makes that shorter.

item.title: What we strip from generated SVG, and why
item.description: The prompt is chosen by somebody else and SVG is a document format with a scripting model attached, so model output gets treated as untrusted input.

item.title: Node count is the number that matters
item.description: A vector file can render perfectly and still be useless to the person who has to edit it.

item.title: What the model actually reads in a sketch
item.description: The vectorize endpoint identifies an upload from its bytes rather than from what the caller claimed, and that decides which sketches survive to reach a model.

item.title: A field guide to prompting for logos
item.description: Adjectives are the least useful part of a logo prompt.

item.title: Reserve, then settle
item.description: Credits leave the balance before the model is called and are settled against what the work actually cost, so a failure returns them instead of charging for nothing.
